question: In which of the following cities was the International Gita Mahotsav held in November- December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kurukshetra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Gita Mahotsav held in November- December 2020 was held in **Kurukshetra**__, Haryana.
 
• In the state of Haryana, a total of 55,000 school kids will recite 19 verses from the Hindu scripture Bhagavad Gita.
 
• The international Gita Mahotsav 2020 was held from December 17 to 25.
 
• Around** 9,000 students** will come from Kurukshetra, where the international festival is held every year, while the rest will come from the state's other 21 districts.
 
• It is celebrated to commemorate the birth of ‘**Srimad Bhagwat Gita**’.
 
• International Gita Mahotsav is traditionally marked by the chanting of Bhagavad Gita verses, the offering of oblations in fire sacrifices (yajna), and the distribution of prasad to devotees.
 
• The Education Department has been tasked with ensuring that all schools are connected to this programme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Patna** is an ancient city in Bihar.

 
 
• Patna's original name was Pataliputra, and its history dates back to the sixth century B.C.
 
 
 
• **Amritsar **is a city in Punjab.
 
 
• Amritsar is home to Harmandir Sahib, popularly known as "the Golden Temple.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai **is the capital city of Maharashtra.
 
 
• Mumbai is the financial capital of India.
